0022600209.text: The Suns (3-5, with a 3-2 home record and a two-game win streak) host the 8-2 Spurs, who have won eight straight and sit first in the Southwest, as Phoenix begins its ninth game of the 2026-27 season. Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Devin Vassell is day-to-day with a groin injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the Suns losing the last meeting 101-100 in San Antonio on March 19, 2026.
